title: GUI: Nuklear backend integration (render bridge to sokol)
acceptance_criteria: Nuklear context created via nk_init_default() or nk_init_custom()
Nuklear input forwarded from sokol_app.h events to nk_input_*
Nuklear command buffer iterated and converted to sokol_gfx draw calls
nk_begin()/nk_end() frame lifecycle integrated into frame callback
Font atlas uploaded as sokol_gfx texture
Vertex/index buffers allocated for Nuklear draw commands
Nuklear renders a test panel with text visible in window
Input events (mouse move, click) update Nuklear state correctly
